authority_boundary: Trust tiers lower intake friction only. Every external item still passes screening (prompt injection, license, provenance, compatibility) and a named human approval before promotion. A tier never authorizes copying external content into DAD or downstream repos.

trust_tiers.high_signal: Frontier labs, professional security firms, and language foundations with strong review culture; intake allowed without extra justification.
trust_tiers.known: Curated community sources with real editorial filtering; intake allowed without extra justification but screen skeptically.
trust_tiers.unknown: Everything else; intake requires an explicit written justification.
